claim: This small exposed set shows fold1 is not a universal public-ranking proxy; it cannot identify a superior public-like fold.
family_independence: Two students and one scratch; fourth endpoint shares their predictions. No statistical test or independent confirmation.
missing_for_fold_comparison: Matched same-recipe siblings on folds0/1/2/3 and more source-qualified public outcomes, stratified by full-data versus heldout fitting, objective, parent/teacher ancestry and native precision.

rows.source: Claude public-gap review and previous portal receipt

selection_policy: CV and local evidence select; public confirms transfer. Do not pick whichever exposed fold gives the desired score, convert local deltas topublic forecasts or call public-adaptive development freshvalidation.
